text: Entry Requirements High school graduation or above; certified transcripts of A-Level course, IB or AP. New HSK 4≥180 (for non-Chinese ethnics) or pass the entrance examination of Chinese in SHUTCM. Applicants emigrating from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan must hold a valid foreign citizenship for no less than 4 years and a record of residency in the country for no less than 2 years in the most recent 4 years (Before April 30, 2024). (Actual residency for 9 months can be counted as one year based on entry and exit stamps). 16-65 years old.
